LESSON: CAPACITY

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement 2.2 Mass By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners in pairs/groups to
Topic 2.3: Capacity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Capacity
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. solve questions on Capacity
2. show clear working for Capacity

SECTION 3: PICTURES

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-062.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 62]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-125.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 125]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-177.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 177]]

SECTION 4: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Capacity

• Read the meaning of Capacity.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Capacity

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Capacity.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Capacity: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Capacity questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Capacity question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Capacity.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a revision sheet for Capacity with 5 worked examples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Show working.
• Check every answer.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
